We are still analyzing the data from the attack, but we can confirm that General Ares Nune's task force did encounter enemy forces on patrol.|[[Unidentified Republic admiral|A Republic admiral]]|{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}}} The '''Bardottan''', also known as '''Phuii''', were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Reptile/Legends|saurian]] bipeds with sagging, wrinkled skin. Their anatomy featured a long, swooping neck, lanky [[Limb/Legends|arms]], and stubby legs. Some Bardottans had long tails, while others did not. Members of the species had a fleshy crest on top of the head and a pronounced growth under each [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. Their needle-pointed snouts were full of blunt [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. The species hailed from [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was renowned for its spirituality. Over the millennia, Bardottans integrated into [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]], settling the gaming world of [[Phu/Legends|Phu]]. Most Bardottans abroad originated from the colony on Phu, and referred to themselves as Phuii. One of these was [[Nep Chung]], a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization, who was killed in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Other Phuii entered the fast-paced sport of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]]. Among them was [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]], regarded as an arrogant blowhard by his colleagues. Guo entered the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], but he was taken out of the race due to the machinations of rival racer, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. Another [[Unidentified Phuii Podracer|Phuii podracer]] crashed and died during the [[Ungasan Cross Country]] on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], and [[Chros-filik]] also podraced on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Phuii [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] patrolled his [[Phu system/Legends|home system]] as a [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]; he was [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|killed]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] ambushed his patrol. ==Biology and appearance== [[File:Black_Sun_Phuii.jpg|thumb|left|Phuii were characterized by a long, curving neck and a pointed, beak-like snout.]] Bardottans were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] bipeds with thin, [[Reptile/Legends|saurian]] bodies.''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'' Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] were characterized by a long, curving neck[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']] with deep-set wrinkles running down its length; and by stubby [[Limb/Legends|legs]] that bent backward to allow the Bardottans to walk on small, three-toed feet. Some Bardottans had four fingers per hand, while others featured three. Although some Bardottans sported a long tail, others did not. Bardottans ranged from about 1 and two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall at maturity. For locomotion, members of the species hopped from place to place.''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''. The Bardottan neck swooped forward to place the small head directly in front of the rest of the body. The eyes, located at the sides of the head, came in shades of red, orange, yellow, and white, with a blue sclera in some individuals. These were surrounded by heavy, baggy wrinkles with a fleshy growth under each. A narrow, dagger-like snout projected forth, filled with white, peg-like [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and pink gums. From the area of the head between the eyes rose a fleshy, lumpy crest. This growth was bulbous toward the front of the head, but it shortened to two raised bumps along the top of the cranium before extending to a point at the back of the head. Other patterns of bumps and crevasses covered the sides of the skull. The wrinkled skin of the Bardottans featured shades of green, yellow, gray, and brown. Although some of the dinosaur-like beings had skin of a single hue, others had distinctive markings. For example, an individual might have had one major skin tone with another for the area around the eyes, the lips, the front of the neck, the belly, and other stripes and mottling. ==Society and culture== {{Quote|Well, hello, Twi'lek! Pull up a seat next to Mars Guo?''"
"''Forget it. I'm with Sebulba.''"
"''Big deal! Listen, if I win the Boonta, let's you and me skip Tatooine!|Mars Guo and Ann Gella|"[[Podracing Tales]]"}} The Bardottans hailed from [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was famed for its monasteries, places of learning, and ancient artifacts. Developing a society with a rich [[The Force/Legends|Force-tradition]] early on in their history, Bardottans were war-like [[Demon/Legends|demon]] worshipers in their earliest years, led by the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl]] in worshiping [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]]. When the [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan]] culture came to power, the Frangawl religion was banned and the Dagoyan practices of peace, meditation, and contemplation became socially entrenched in the culture of Bardotta. The Dagoyan Order represented the religious aspects of the Bardottans, while the [[Bahk-tov Council/Legends|Bahk-tov Council]] and the Monarch of Bardotta presided over the government. All education on the world took place in Dagoyan schools, though belief in the tradition was not mandatory. Valuing knowledge and spiritual devotion, Bardottans were scholarly and insular when it came to outsiders and sharing their knowledge. All Bardottans were proud and independent, feeling shame when forced to ask for assistance. Cities on Bardotta were clustered around different academic and religious studies, studying in their own fields and sharing with other cities if asked. The right to education was earned through intense study and devotion, never handed out freely. Most Bardottans in the galaxy were from [[Phu/Legends|Phu]], a world made famous for its gaming industry.''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' The Bardottans of Phu were commonly identified as Phuii, both abroad and by themselves. Phuii were capable of using [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-standard technology.{{Film|I}} A style of clothing favored by several members of the species was a set of coveralls with horizontal straps that left the shoulders and upper chest exposed. A Bardottan could employ its beak to peck at an opponent in combat.''[[Star Wars: Head-to-Head Tag Teams]]'' The symbol of the planet Phu was an orange crescent with a loop between its two points, set against a green field; the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] flew this flag at the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Members of the species could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. Phuii had two-part names. In some, the two elements were completely separate. Examples included Nep Chung, Mars Guo, and Ares Nune. Others hyphenated the two parts to form a name such as Chros-Fillik.{{CSWECite|I|126|Chros-Fillik}} ==History== {{Quote|General Ares Nune reporting. Am commencing another sweep of the Phu system and surrounding area. Still no sign of any Separatist activity. It's like the great slug from that old story, eh, Commander Kite? The one that's lurking out there, waiting to be found.|Jedi General Ares Nune|}} [[File:Kite_and_Ares_Nune_full_body.png|thumb|right|The Phuii Jedi Ares Nune served as a Republic general during the Clone Wars.]] The early history of the Bardottan people was a violent and war-like one. Ruled by the Frangawl, the tribes of Bardotta fought for dominance, finding strength in pain and torture. When the competing school of thought, known as Dagoyan gained momentum, they slowly dismantled the Frangawl way of life and expounded strength through intellectual pursuits and the arts. Banning the Frangawl tradition and converting their temples and holy sites into palaces and meditative retreats, the Dagoyans gained complete control over Bardottan culture and established themselves at the reigning force on Bardotta. Under the leadership of the [[Bahk-tov Council/Legends|Bahk-tov Council]], the planet elected a monarch who governed with the assistance of the Dagoyan Masters and the [[High Seneschal/Legends|High Seneschal]]. Undergoing a brief era of expansion into the greater galaxy, Bardottans settled several worlds, most notably Phu. The Phuii first encountered visitors from another planet sometime between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]]. However, their world lay beyond the regions of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that were thoroughly integrated into the greater galaxy until at least the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. At the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in 22 BBY, Phu lay beyond the borders of any supraplanetary entity, such as the Galactic Republic or [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Despite this isolation, the Phuii [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] was assigned to patrol the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] for Separatist activity for part of the war. He [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|came under fire]] from an unknown enemy—the Separatist ship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]—and lost shields on his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], ''[[Laudable]]''. He was killed along with his crew. A different Phuii served the Confederacy during the conflict, as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] aboard a starship captained by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Aviso]].''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Dooku's Secret Army]]'' The population of the Phu homeworld fell somewhere between 10 and 100 million circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The planet had fallen within territory considered part of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] by [[137 ABY]]. ==Phuii in the galaxy== [[File:Mars_Guo_before_crash.png|thumb|left|Mars Guo's podracing career led him to the Boonta Eve Classic of 32 BBY.]] Despite their homeworld's relative isolation from galactic affairs, Bardottans spread from Bardotta to colonize several other worlds, most notably Phu from which they made their way into the greater galaxy. At least a decade before [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Phuii [[Nep Chung]] had become a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. Chung and his [[Unidentified Phuii bodyguard|Phuii bodyguard]] attended a meeting of the Vigos in the fortress of [[Alexi Garyn]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] that year to discuss the [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]] of two other Vigos. When the assassin, a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], arrived to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the rest of the Vigos, Chung's bodyguard confronted him along with other enforcers for the assemblage. Maul killed the bodyguards and continued into the chamber where Chung and the other Vigos were hiding. He then slew the Vigos as well.[[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 4]]. Some members of the species found employment in the fast-paced sport of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]]. One such Phuii was [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]], who began his career in the [[minor rim leagues]]. He had proven a favorite in the [[Spice Mine Run]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]],[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]. and he had just won the [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]] [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]] when he moved up to the professional circuit with his entry into the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Guo's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] found him to be a cruel master,{{DB|character|paxbonkik|Bonkik, Pax}}. and his colleagues found him to be an egotistical braggart.''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]'' This behavior got him into trouble the night before the race when Guo had too much to drink and hit on [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann Gella]], an enslaved [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] masseuse owned by a rival podracer, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. During the race, the Dug flung a piece of scrap into the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] of Guo's [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat]] [[Plug-2 Behemoth]] racer. Guo crashed, and he was eventually placed in a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]]. [[Unidentified Phuii Podracer|Another Phuii podracer]] entered the [[Ungasan Cross Country]] on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}} sometime before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].According to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}, the Cross Country was exposed as an illegal front for a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation in 27 BBY and forced to cease operations, so the Phuii must have raced in that year or before. This racer fatally crashed in the [[Juaka Canyon]]. Years later, the remains of his pod were the site of a fight between the Twi'lek [[Ree]] and a group of Ando Prime's native [[Talid/Legends|Talids]]. [[Chros-filik]] was another Phuii podracer active in the latter years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He entered a race on Tatooine in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|How do you take a Podracer pilot seriously who looks like this and whose species is called Phuii? Clearly, you don't!|[[Stephen J. Sansweet]]|''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]''}} The podracer pilot Mars Guo was the first Phuii to appear in a ''[[Star Wars]]'' story. The character was designed by concept artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]]''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]'' for the Boonta Eve Classic sequences of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], a film released in [[1999]]. Concept sketches of the species include a long, tapered tail, an element removed in the final design. Unlike most of the other podracer characters, the Phuii was an articulated puppet for closeup shots. However, for wide shots of Guo in his pod, the character was computer-generated. Early plans for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] called for a Phuii to be among the patrons of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but such a character never made it to the final film.{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Phuii}} *''[[Episode I
